snippet.title: Northfall - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🌲 Survival horror set in the 90s Pacific Northwest. Will you survive the infected?

Build your camp, manage resources, and fight for every single day in Northfall. One mistake means game over! 🪓👀

Watch the trailer & Add to Wishlist on Steam! 👇
